description.value: Zac-Zac Japanese Curry House is a small Japanese curry specialist on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver, offering a focused menu of rice-based and udon curry dishes with a wide range of protein options from chicken katsu to ebi furai. The restaurant sits one level above street level and offers online ordering with pick-up and local delivery. It is a solid quick-fuel stop in the heart of Vancouver's shopping and cycling corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 18m; stands (2 spaces) at 26m; stands (2 spaces) at 53m; stands (4 spaces) at 83m; stands (4 spaces) at 88m; stands (4 spaces) at 90m; stands (8 spaces) at 96m. Total: 28 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is actively open at 590 Robson St, Vancouver with phone (604) 608-2887, matching OSM. The website explicitly advertises pick-up ordering, confirming takeout. Multiple vegetarian curry dishes (Vegetable Curry, Eggplant Curry, Spinaegg Curry, Cheese Curry, Spinacheesy Curry) are listed on the menu. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other amenities was found in either OSM tags or the website.
concerns: OSM tag level=1 indicates the restaurant is one floor above street level, which may be relevant for cyclists managing loaded bikes.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating restaurant confirmed by website and recent OSM check date (2026-04-27). Publicly accessible food stop on a major Vancouver street.
